task.title: Workshop session/event persistence
task.summary_zh: 依 SD §6.5 在 control-plane Postgres 建立 strategy_workshop_session / strategy_workshop_event / strategy_completeness_snapshot 三表與 persistence,event 只存 private_content_ref + redacted_summary(私人原文進加密 store,不落 event payload)。Workshop session 不複製 StrategySpec 真相,只引用 registry draft id。含 §22.6 索引 (workshop_id,created_at) 等與 §17.2 list/create/get workshop endpoint。 【有疑問一定要提出,不要自己亂做】動工前先讀完引用的設計稿(SD 對應章節 + docs/04/pantheon_agora_cross_repo_2026-06-20/design-closure/ + canonical services/control-plane/specs/agora/*.schema.json / openapi/agora_v1.openapi.yaml / capability_manifest.json)。只要遇到任何疑問、不確定、設計稿沒寫到、與既有 code 對不上、依賴不清、無法重現或衝突,一律 STOP,用 blocker(或向 reviewer handoff)把問題具體寫出來並等待澄清,絕對不可自行臆測、補洞、繞過或先做再說。可動工的部分必須與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致:不得自創 schema/欄位/評分/widget/route、不得擴張 capability allowlist、不得讓 Agora 直接下單/綁資金/寫 RuntimeBinding。
acceptance: 可建立/讀取 workshop session 與 event;event 不含私人原文(只 ref+redacted);completeness snapshot 可持久化;migration 與索引到位;附測試;【驗收】實作與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致,無自創欄位/route/enum;遇疑問須先開 blocker 澄清而非自行實作;自行臆測或偏離設計稿一律不通過

blockers.message: Blocked before implementation: AG-BE-SW-001 summary requires SD §6.5/§17.2/§22.6 for strategy_workshop_session, strategy_workshop_event, strategy_completeness_snapshot, indexes, and list/create/get workshop endpoints, but docs/04/pantheon_agora_cross_repo_2026-06-20/SD_2026-06-20.md has no §6.5/§17.2/§22.6 content for these tables/routes and frozen OpenAPI/capability_manifest omit /bff/agora/workshops; task rules forbid inventing routes/fields or expanding capability allowlist. Please provide the missing phase-2 SD or approve the exact contract changes before implementation.

Blocked before implementation: AG-BE-SW-001 requires WorkshopCreateRequest.initial_message private raw content to be written to an encrypted/private store while strategy_workshop_event stores only private_content_ref + redacted_summary, but the checked sources define no encrypted/private content store API, no key/retention contract, and no request field for a pre-stored private_content_ref. Also need clarification for mapping OpenAPI strategy_spec_ref onto strategy_workshop_session.strategy_id and active_strategy_spec_registry_id without copying StrategySpec truth; exact §22.6 index set is not present in checked design sources; schema status enum open/in_review/concluded/archived conflicts with OpenAPI status filter wording active/concluded/archived.

BLOCKER[private-content-store-absent]: The task brief and reviewer both require raw workshop content (initial_message / message.content) to be persisted to an encrypted private-content store before the event table receives only private_content_ref. No such store service, client interface, DSN env var, or dependency is defined anywhere in this codebase. Design doc B2 mentions a 'private object store' but provides no API contract, endpoint, or env var. Current code emits priv-content-stub:// refs which are non-functional. Needed before this can be wired: (a) definition of the encrypted store interface (client class, HTTP endpoint or gRPC, auth mechanism, env vars), (b) whether a stub/noop implementation is acceptable behind a feature flag, or (c) explicit decision that priv-content-stub refs satisfy the requirement for this phase. Cannot self-implement — task brief forbids assumption-based infill.
